intent.instructions: What is the person trying to create with this text

criteria.event: Scheduling a meeting, meal, call or gathering at a time, usually with other people
criteria.reminder: Asking to be reminded to do a single task themselves, e.g. 'remind me to…'
criteria.todo: Listing several separate things to do or buy
criteria.timer: Starting a timer, countdown, focus session or stopwatch for a duration
criteria.habit: Something they want to do repeatedly as a routine, e.g. daily or weekly
criteria.color: Referring to a color: a hex code, rgb value, or a described color
criteria.split: Dividing an amount of money between several people
criteria.expense: Recording money they spent on something
criteria.convert: Converting a value from one unit of measurement to another
criteria.calc: A math calculation or percentage that is not splitting money or converting units
criteria.travel: Planning a trip, flight, train or stay to a destination
criteria.poll: Asking a group to choose between options
criteria.contact: Saving a person's name with a phone number or email address
criteria.link: Saving a web link or URL, optionally with a note
criteria.countdown: Counting the days until a future date, holiday or event
criteria.timezone: Converting a time of day between time zones or cities, or asking the time somewhere
criteria.random: Asking for a random result: rolling dice, flipping a coin, a random number or letting chance pick
criteria.goal: Tracking progress toward a numeric target, such as 4 of 12 books read or money saved
criteria.note: Writing a thought, idea or note that is none of the above
criteria.none: Too short, unclear or unfinished to tell yet

readiness.instructions: How complete is this input for what the person is creating
criteria: Fully specified, ready to act on

isQuestion.instructions: The text is a question rather than an instruction or statement

recurring.instructions: The text describes something that repeats on a schedule

urgency.instructions: How urgent or time-sensitive the text sounds

tone.instructions: The emotional tone of the text

criteria.neutral: Plain and factual, no clear emotion
criteria.excited: Enthusiastic or looking forward to something

eventMode.instructions: How the gathering or meeting would take place

criteria.video_call: A video call such as Zoom, Meet or FaceTime
criteria.unspecified: Not mentioned or not a meeting
Not mentioned or not about travel
Not mentioned or not about travel

expenseCategory.instructions: What the money was spent on

criteria.other: Something else or not about spending

colorMood.instructions: The feel of the color described

timerKind.instructions: What kind of timer is wanted

criteria.countdown: A plain countdown for a duration
criteria.stopwatch: Counting up with no end time

hasExplicitOptions.instructions: The text names two or more explicit options to pick between

isShoppingList.instructions: The listed items are things to buy

fromZone.instructions: If the text converts a time between places or zones, the IANA time zone name (like America/New_York) of the SOURCE: the zone a stated clock time belongs to, or the place the person is asking from. Empty string if none is named or this is not about time zones.

toZone.instructions: If the text asks what time it is somewhere or converts a time TO a place or zone, the IANA time zone name (like Asia/Tokyo) of that destination. Empty string if none or not about time zones.
